_comment: Edit the three numbers below to move a region boundary; forecast_core.region() reads this file (falls back to these same values if the file is missing). Replaces the package's original 4-region split (Hindu Kush, Kohistan-Hazara, Kashmir, Karakoram) with 3 regions.
_lon_hindu_kush_max_note: West of this longitude is always Hindu Kush, at any latitude.
_lat_split_note: At or above this latitude and east of lon_hindu_kush_max: Hindu Kush if also west of lon_karakoram_min (Hindu Raj / Ghizer / Yasin), else Karakoram. Below it: West Himalaya (Hazara, lower Kohistan, Neelum, Leepa, Astore).
_lon_karakoram_min_note: At or above lat_split, this longitude is where Hindu Kush ends and Karakoram begins.
